mapper.sql: select run_id, trigger_source, started_at, finished_at, candidate_count, success_count, fail_count, skipped_count, create_time from kms_auto_update_run

select i.item_id, i.run_id, i.key_id, i.user_id, i.user_name, i.key_name, i.encryt_name, i.result, i.reason, i.from_version, i.to_version, i.updated_at, i.create_time, cor.result_status as chain_result_status, cor.chain_hash as chain_hash, cor.block_height as block_height from kms_auto_update_item i left join key_operation_record cor on cor.record_id = ( select max(r.record_id) from key_operation_record r where r.key_id = i.key_id and r.action_source = 'AUTO' )
mapper.insert: insert into kms_auto_update_run ( run_id, trigger_source, started_at, finished_at, candidate_count, success_count, fail_count, skipped_count, create_time ) values ( #{runId}, #{triggerSource}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, 0, 0, 0, 0, now() )
mapper.update: update kms_auto_update_run set finished_at = #{finishedAt}, candidate_count = #{candidateCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount} where run_id = #{runId}
mapper.insert:
insert into kms_auto_update_item ( run_id, key_id, user_id, user_name, key_name, encryt_name, result, reason, from_version, to_version, updated_at, create_time ) values
